caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile sample with a repeating geometric and floral pattern. The textile features a background composed of alternating horizontal bands in red, brown, and black, with jagged edges where the colors meet. Across the center, there are three large horizontal medallions filled with blue and turquoise floral motifs outlined in yellow with white and brown accents. Smaller yellow floral motifs surround the blue medallions. Scattered among the bands are diamond-shaped motifs in blue, green, yellow, and brown. The texture and layout of the design suggest a woven fabric. The textile sample is set against an off-white background with some red handwritten text in the lower right corner outside the fabric area.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
